reason: At my size I already pitch brands every week off my own rate card and keep 100% of it, so handing over $50 on every $500 deal to a new platform with barely any brands doesn't add anything for me. The growth stuff sounds like the generic hook advice I can get for free.
objection: Why would I give up 10% when the platform is new and the brands are small? I'd be paying a cut to get access to fewer, cheaper deals than the ones I land myself.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that there are real brands on there booking creators my size at $1,000+ per post, so it brings me deals I wouldn't get on my own instead of taxing the ones I already have.
